admin.accounts.empty: No upstream accounts yet. Use "Add account" in the top right.
admin.accounts.poolDescription: Each account configures its own available models; accounts with the same priority are dispatched by weight, and maxConcurrency 0 means unlimited.
admin.accounts.priceEmpty: No pricing yet. Add one to start billing.
admin.accounts.priceMeta: Input {input} · Output {output} · Cache read {cacheRead} · Cache write {cacheWrite}
admin.accounts.pricingDescription: User-facing model names are customizable and can bind to a real upstream model; prices are in cents per 1M tokens, use * for the fallback price. Cache price 0 means bill at the input rate, multiplier 100 = 1x. Capability tags are shown to users.
admin.accounts.title: Upstream accounts & pricing
admin.editor.accountOverviewDescription: Used for model request forwarding once configured.
admin.editor.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key
admin.editor.basicDescription: Enter the upstream connection details and scheduling parameters.
admin.editor.billingUnit: Prices are in cents per 1M tokens.
admin.editor.catalogContext: Context limits: {input} input tokens, {output} output tokens
admin.editor.catalogDesc: Look up a reference price from the public catalog (LiteLLM, 4400+ models) and copy it into cost or sell price.
admin.editor.catalogDisabled: Reference prices are turned off (rate set to 0). Set the rate back to roughly 700 in system settings to re-enable.
admin.editor.catalogHasTiers: This model has {count} long-context tiers you can copy into "Tiers" below.
admin.editor.catalogHasWindows: This model has {count} off-peak windows you can copy into "Time-of-day pricing" below.
admin.editor.catalogHelp: Reference prices are public list prices, for comparison only: your actual cost may differ due to channel discounts, and the sell price is yours to set.
admin.editor.catalogHolidayGap: This model's off-peak pricing has no holiday rule: DeepSeek bills public holidays entirely at off-peak rates, but the public data source has no such field. Add an all-day window per holiday, otherwise holiday traffic is billed at peak rates.
admin.editor.catalogMore: {count} more candidates with the same name (channel prices differ); the closest one was used.
admin.editor.catalogNeedModel: Enter the user-facing model name first.
admin.editor.catalogNoMatch: The public catalog has no entry for "{model}"; please price it manually.
admin.editor.catalogNotCost: Reference price = USD list price × rate; it is NOT what this upstream actually charges you. Enter the real cost from your invoice.
admin.editor.catalogPrices: Input {input} / output {output} per million tokens (rate 1 USD = {rate})
admin.editor.catalogUnavailable: Public price catalog is temporarily unavailable; manual pricing still works.
admin.editor.catalogUsd: Public list price: ${input} / ${output} per million tokens (USD)
admin.editor.costHelp: Cost prices are for margin reporting only; they never charge users. 0 means unknown.
admin.editor.exprHelp: Variables: prompt_tokens / completion_tokens / cache_read_tokens / cache_write_tokens / reasoning_tokens / image_count / audio_seconds / multiplier; functions: min / max / round / ceil / floor / abs. The result is the charged amount in minor units (multiplier is not applied again).
admin.editor.missingApiKey: Please fill in the upstream API key first
admin.editor.missingBaseUrl: Please fill in the base URL first
admin.editor.modelsEmpty: No model list yet. Fill in Base URL / API key then "Fetch from upstream", or add models manually.
admin.editor.name: Name
admin.editor.priceMissing: This price no longer exists or was deleted; go back to the list.
admin.editor.priceNotesBody: A multiplier of 100% means list price. A cache price of 0 bills at the input rate. Changes only affect future requests and never rewrite past invoices.
admin.editor.providerHelp: Different entry protocols are converted automatically; the same protocol is passed through first.
admin.editor.tiersDesc: When input tokens exceed a threshold, that tier's prices apply; empty fields inherit the base price above.
admin.editor.tiersEmpty: No tiers configured; every request uses the base price.
admin.editor.upstreamModelPlaceholder: Empty = same as the user model name
admin.editor.userModel: User model name (public / called by clients)
admin.editor.userModelHelp: Use * for the fallback price; the model name cannot be changed when editing.
admin.editor.windowHoursHelp: Format HH:MM-HH:MM; an end earlier than the start means it crosses midnight (e.g. 22:00-02:00).
admin.editor.windowPercentHelp: 50 means half the base price during this window; setting a percentage disables unit prices.
admin.editor.windowWeekdaysHelp: None selected = every day; a cross-midnight window belongs to its start day.
admin.editor.windowsDesc: When a request arrives inside a window, that window's discount or unit prices override the base price.
admin.editor.windowsEmpty: No windows configured; one price applies all day.
